title: finding(app-shell): `applyViewItem` makes a container's FIRST named form its create/edit `.form` when no item is default — the first-named promotion objectstack#21500 removes from the spec
body:
Filing gate: **① a product defect, class (b), against a declared contract.** `reach:` named producer, `examples/app-showcase` `showcase_inquiry` (below), measured by running the console's own rule on served rows. Filed by objectstack's `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_01YDt3PzwfrkuFzUBF89WPmM`, seat post objectstack#18549), from the objectstack#21500 dev report `5965453403` (out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Contract

`@objectstack/spec` `ViewSchema`: `form` is the container's **"Default form view"**, and `formViews` are **"Additional named form views"**.

## What changes upstream

objectstack-ai/objectstack PR #21535 (objectstack#21500, triage `5964333435`, Q2 A) stops the spec's view-container expansion from promoting a container's first named form to default. A container with no `form` now serves its named forms with **no** `isDefault` item. Only `OBJECT.form` (the container's `form`) is ever flagged default.

## Where objectui does the same promotion

`packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`, `applyViewItem`. It reads the same at the `.objectui-sha` pin `89cad75d55` and on objectui `main` `8bfc0012ea`:

```ts
bucket.formViews[key] = entry;
if (view.isDefault || !bucket.form) bucket.form = entry;   // :424
```

When no served form item carries `isDefault`, the first form item to arrive becomes `bucket.form`. The renderers read `.form` for create and edit (`RecordFormPage`, `useActionModal`, per objectstack#21500's body).

## Measured

The objectstack dev extracted `viewItemBody` and `applyViewItem` verbatim at the pin and ran them on the rows PR #21535's branch serves:
- `showcase_inquiry` (`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/inquiry.view.ts`) has only `formViews.contact`. That is the **public, anonymous contact-us form**: its docblock, `sharing.allowAnonymous` and `publicLink` say so. It is served with no `isDefault`, and the console still makes `showcase_inquiry.contact` its `.form`, so it renders as the create/edit form.
- Controls on the same branch: `crm_lead` → `.form = crm_lead.form`, and `showcase_contact` → `.form = showcase_contact.form`. When a default exists, the rule picks it.

So after PR #21535 lands and objectui reads its served rows, the first-named promotion the spec removed still happens, in the console.

## Expected (by the contract)

A container with no `form` declares no default form. `.form` stays unset, so create and edit fall back to what objectui renders for an object with no default form view. A named form is reached only by name. Whatever that fallback is, it should not be the first named form, which can be a public intake form or a wizard.

## Seam

`spec:ViewSchema.form` → served `ViewItem.isDefault` → renderer: objectui `MetadataProvider.tsx` `applyViewItem` (`.form`) → `RecordFormPage` / `useActionModal`.

## Not in scope here

objectui's bundled `expandViewContainer`, which handles an unexpanded container, picks up PR #21535 at objectui's normal `@objectstack/spec` bump (triage `5964333435`). This card is only about the served-row merge rule.

**Dedupe:** the 100 most recently updated open objectui issues were listed by REST and grepped (title and body) for `applyViewItem`, `first form`, `bucket.form` and `default form`: 0 hits. Dedupe words: applyViewItem first form fallback · console promotes first named form · bucket.form no isDefault · showcase_inquiry contact create form · formViews first entry console default.
